_doc: One file per place; see places_build.py. Amounts in reais. The debt component, history and facts are refreshed by pipeline/fetch_brazil.py from BCB SGS series 13761 and 13762; edit wording here, not numbers.
name: Brazil
title: Brazil Debt Clock: Live Gross Government Debt, Official Data
headline: gross government debt
subject: The Brazilian general government (federal, state and municipal)
sum_note: Brazil's general government gross debt (Dívida Bruta do Governo Geral, DBGG), month-end, from the Banco Central do Brasil. The closest Brazilian measure to the US Total Public Debt Outstanding: gross, not net of assets.
scope_note: This is the Banco Central do Brasil's gross general government debt (DBGG, SGS series 13761): the debt of the federal government, the social security system (INSS), and state and municipal governments, in reais and before subtracting any assets. It does not include state-owned companies or the Central Bank's own liabilities. Under the Central Bank's methodology, in use since 2008, it does include the Central Bank's repurchase operations with government securities, because of their link to Treasury debt, but not the Treasury securities held in the Central Bank's own portfolio. The Central Bank also publishes net public sector debt, which subtracts assets and is a different measure. The page shows the DBGG as a share of GDP as a fact.
trend_why: We use 12 months rather than the last month because month-to-month changes swing with auctions and redemptions.
legend: Brazil's gross government debt is reported monthly, at month-end. Issuance happens in lumps at auctions and maturities, so the live number is a straight-line projection between official month-end figures, shown here next to them.
cadence: Monthly. The Banco Central do Brasil publishes each month-end figure about a month after the month ends (series 13761).
after_text: , about a month after each month-end
next_update: The October 2026 month-end figure is expected from the Banco Central do Brasil about a month after the month ends; this page re-bases to it automatically on the next daily build after it appears.

components.includes: Gross debt of the federal government (including the INSS social security system) and of state and municipal governments, owed to the private sector, public financial institutions and abroad. Includes the Central Bank's repurchase operations with government securities; excludes state-owned companies and the Central Bank's own liabilities.

facts.note: The same series expressed as a share of GDP by the Banco Central do Brasil (series 13762). A year earlier (2025-09-30) it was 77.84% of GDP.

notes: Why this measure: DBGG is the headline gross debt statistic in Brazil's fiscal reporting. It is broader than the federal Treasury debt alone because it includes state and municipal governments.
Gross, not net: this is not net of the government's assets. The Banco Central do Brasil publishes net public sector debt separately.
